      "snippet": "Understood—and it is doable on your phone, as long as we’re explicit about two constraints:

Android/Termux won’t reliably “hook” every download event from every app in real time without deeper Android integration.

We can still achieve the outcome you want with a safe, local, automatic indexer that runs on a short interval (polling) and maintains a manifest.

So the next phase is:
Phase 7: Auto-Index + Manifest for Downloads
What you’ll get

A manifest that updates automatically for /sdcard/Dow"
